source.title: Ballymoney Free Press and Northern Counties Advertiser, 1 May 1924, p. 3 ("Local government elections: Coleraine Rural Council")
source.publisher: Ballymoney Free Press and Northern Counties Advertiser (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Read on the page image of the Ballymoney Free Press nomination list of 1 May 1924 (council-audit, Nov 2026): 'Downhill—*Hugh Hezlett, J.P., Liffock'.

note: Triennial election of the twenty-one members of Coleraine rural district, one member each. Every candidate was returned unopposed and there was no contest. Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Corrected from the page image of the Ballymoney Free Press and Northern Counties Advertiser, 1 May 1924, p. 3 (council-audit, Nov 2026): Hugh Hezlett, J.P. as printed (was Heslett, an OCR misread).
